summary.name: Suno
summary.one_liner: Suno is an AI music generator that creates complete songs with vocals, lyrics and production from a text prompt.
keywords: compared to short instrumental loop generators
use_cases: Creating a full original song from a text prompt
Making royalty free music for YouTube, podcasts or ads
Writing and producing songs from your own lyrics
Editing and extending AI-generated tracks in a browser studio
summary.what_it_does: Suno generates complete songs, including vocals, lyrics and full production, from a plain-language prompt describing genre, mood, theme or lyrics, with the page claiming generation in under a minute. Users can regenerate, extend or refine tracks after creation. The free tier allows up to 10 songs a day without a credit card. The paid Pro plan adds 500 songs a month, commercial use rights, v5.5 model access, the Song Editor, stem separation into vocal and instrument stems, and audio uploads up to 8 minutes. The Premier plan adds 2,000 songs a month, Suno Studio (a multitrack editor with MIDI export and Persona Voices), and early feature access.
notable: Generates complete songs with vocals, lyrics and production rather than short instrumental loops
Suno Studio, described as a generative audio workstation with multitrack editing and MIDI export (Premier plan)
Stem separation into vocal and instrument stems (Pro plan and above)
Featured in Rolling Stone, Billboard, Wired and Variety, per the page
caveats: Free tier is limited to 10 songs a day; more songs and commercial rights require paid Pro or Premier plans
Paid plans are subscription-based, with a 20% discount for annual billing
Pricing details are as stated on the page and may have changed
